ai-translator.dashboard.retranslateWarni: Warning: All existing translations will be overwritten. This will retranslate all content, not just new strings.
ai-translator.dashboard.infoMessage: Incremental mode skips entries that are already up-to-date. For entries where the source was updated after the translation, all fields are retranslated (Strapi does not track which specific field changed). To translate or edit a single field, open the entry in the Editor.
ai-translator.dashboard.infoMessageAI: Our AI translator understands context, supports 165 languages, preserves formatting and structure, and follows grammar and plural form rules. It produces natural, human-like translations.
ai-translator.dashboard.inProgressMessag: Translation in progress. AI translation takes time as the AI processes your content. The app translates in real-time and does not store your content on our servers. Please do not leave this page until translation is complete.
